purpose: Single structural v2 hypothesis after Phase 0 attribution and Phase 1 IC diagnostics. This file is research-only and does not alter production D-weight-policy or screener behavior.

consumed_holdout.rule: Do not rerun or tune on this holdout. It was used once and remains only exploratory context for v2 design.

confirmation_window.rule: Only forward data observed after 2026-06-16 can confirm or reject v2.

discipline.dsr_trials_rationale: Phase 1 produced 20 factors x 3 horizons x 3 IC types = 180 exploratory summary cells. Future DSR/PSR disclosure must use at least this trial count unless a stricter count is warranted.

soft_shrink_gate.scope: research v2 default weights only; no production screener or D-weight-policy change
soft_shrink_gate.interpretation: evidence-weighted exploratory shrinkage; not alpha confirmation
soft_shrink_gate.frozen_note: Changing these ramp intervals requires a new v2.1 preregistration, not tuning on the current development set.

evidence_inputs.gate_reason: Meaningful exploratory IC appears in valuation, low volatility, low turnover, reversal, and liquidity structure. Original fundamental/growth/safety dimensions were mostly near noise.

objective.name: J
objective.evaluation_note: Training diagnostics may use data up to 2026-06-16, but cannot be reported as confirmation.

candidate.hypothesis: A constrained value + low volatility + low turnover + reversal structure has more exploratory IC support than the original five-dimension fundamental score, provided liquidity and concentration risks are bounded.

score_components.name: guarded_liquidity_premium
score_components.guardrail: Do not allow this component to select names failing the liquidity floor.

risk_guards.liquidity_floor: Exclude bottom 10% by liquidity_amount_20d among eligible stocks before final selection.
risk_guards.industry_cap: No single industry above 20% of selected names.
risk_guards.board_cap: STAR_688 + ChiNext_300 + ChiNext_301 combined share no higher than 40% of selected names.
risk_guards.single_name_stickiness_review: If a name appears in more than 9 of the first 12 forward monthly selections, flag for review but do not tune rules mid-confirmation.
risk_guards.entry_filters: Reuse Phase C eligible-at-entry filter for trade_status, positive close/preclose, and limit-lock threshold.

explicitly_not_included: No reuse of value_tilt holdout performance as evidence of v2 validity.
No marketing claims about win rate, accuracy, alpha, stability, or investability.
next_allowed_step: Implement v2 research-only scorer/backtest wrapper for train diagnostics, then wait for real forward data after 2026-06-16 for confirmation.
